description: '''Thall''' is a [[microgenre]] of [[progressive metal]], considered adjacent to or a further subgenre of the subgenre [[djent]]. Stemming from an in-joke of the band [[Vildhjarta]], the genre became a more definitive [[neologism]] after continued use by the band and other acts like [[Allt]] and [[Humanity's Last Breath]] in the 2020s, particularly by musician [[Buster Odeholm]]. The genre differs from djent in its heavy use of dissonance, pairing the distorted polyrhymic lead guitar typical to djent with clean guitar riffs and ambient sections.
